adjudication.rationale: In the new `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb`, the tests call `get :best` and assert status/headers, but never enable `render_views`, and they stub out key objects (`TopicView.expects(:new)` / `TopicRetriever`). In rspec-rails controller specs, views are not rendered/compiled unless `render_views` is used, so the newly added templates (`app/views/embed/best.html.erb`, `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb`) and layout (`app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb`) are not exercised by any spec in the diff. That means template syntax/runtime issues (e.g., the unusual `<%- end if %>` in `best.html.erb`, the `raw post.cooked` rendering, or the `postMessage` script in the layout) could still ship and cause 500s without failing the suite. This is a concrete, diff-grounded test coverage gap rather than a proven defect.
